description: This file implements the MongoQueryBuilder class, which provides a builder pattern to construct MongoDB queries based on criteria, sorting, limit, and skip parameters. It specifically implements the QueryBuilder interface for building query objects suited for MongoDB.

classes.name: MongoQueryBuilder
classes.description: A thread-unsafe builder for constructing MongoDB query objects with criteria, sorting, limits, and skip options.

methods.name: limited
methods.description: Creates a MongoQueryBuilder instance for a limited (paged) query with specified maxPageSize and defaultPageSize.

methods.name: unlimited
methods.description: Creates a MongoQueryBuilder instance set for an unlimited query (e.g., count).

methods.name: sort
methods.description: Sets sorting options for the query, ensuring the inclusion of the ID sort option after the specified options.

methods.name: limit
methods.description: Sets the maximum number of results to return, validated against maxLimit.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Alias for limit, setting the size of the result set, validated accordingly.

methods.name: skip
methods.description: Sets the number of results to skip, validated accordingly.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Constructs and returns a MongoQuery object with the specified criteria, sorting, limit, and skip.
